dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (DLBCL, NOS)

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: Immunophenotype is non-germinal-center B-cell-like (non-GCB/ABC-like) by the Hans algorithm

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor stage IIIB with splenic involvement (IIIS), bulky.

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: with multiple FDG-avid splenic lesions; because the spleen is a lymphatic organ, this remains stage III rather than IV.

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: Bulky disease is present (retroperitoneal mass 11.0 cm, greater than 10 cm). B symptoms are present (fever to 38.5 C, drenching night sweats)

mn_stage_iv.quote: because the spleen is a lymphatic organ, this remains stage III rather than IV.

mn_spleen_extranodal_count.quote: IPI 3 (high-intermediate) and NCCN-IPI 4 (high) reflect age over 60, stage III, and LDH 735 U/L

mol_de_not_dh.quote: It is a double-expressor lymphoma by immunohistochemistry (BCL2 about 80%, MYC about 50%, Ki-67 about 85%), but FISH is negative for MYC, BCL2, and BCL6 rearrangements, so it is not double-hit

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: FISH shows no MYC, BCL2, or BCL6 rearrangement, excluding double-hit lymphoma; the morphology is DLBCL, NOS rather than high-grade B-cell lymphoma.

mn_denies_double_expressor.quote: It is a double-expressor lymphoma by immunohistochemistry (BCL2 about 80%, MYC about 50%, Ki-67 about 85%)

prog_ipi_3.quote: IPI 3 (high-intermediate) and NCCN-IPI 4 (high) reflect age over 60, stage III, and LDH 735 U/L, which is 3.3 times the upper limit of normal

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.quote: CNS-IPI 2 (age over 60 and stage III), which is intermediate risk (approximately 4% 2-year CNS relapse).

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Curative intent. I recommend polatuzumab vedotin plus R-CHP (pola-R-CHP) every 21 days for 6 cycles: polatuzumab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg IV day 1 (replacing vincristine), rituximab 375 mg/m2 IV day 1, cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2

tx_pola_preferred.quote: This is a preferred NCCN category 1 option for advanced DLBCL with IPI at least 2, and in POLARIX it improved 2-year progression-free survival versus R-CHOP

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: if Deauville 4-5 at the bulky site, biopsy and consider involved-site radiation.

mn_non_curative.quote: Cure remains the goal, and I would not treat this as palliative.

mn_da_epoch.quote: I would not use DA-EPOCH-R: FISH is negative for MYC/BCL2/BCL6 rearrangements, so this is not double-hit lymphoma

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: He is fit for full-dose curative anthracycline-based therapy: age 62, ECOG 1, fully independent, working part-time, LVEF 58%

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: monitor HBV DNA every 2-3 months during rituximab and for 6-12 months afterward, and start entecavir or tenofovir if DNA becomes detectable.

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.quote: Before cycle 1 I still need: quantitative HBV DNA (he is anti-HBc positive)

mn_no_hbv_action.quote: Hepatitis B: because anti-HBc is positive but HBsAg is negative and anti-HBs is positive, monitor HBV DNA every 2-3 months during rituximab

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: I will not give intrathecal chemotherapy or high-dose methotrexate prophylaxis, and I will not perform a routine baseline lumbar puncture with CSF flow cytometry.

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: I will not give intrathecal chemotherapy or high-dose methotrexate prophylaxis

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT will be obtained 6-8 weeks after cycle 6 and interpreted by Lugano 2014/Deauville criteria.

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: If the 11-cm retroperitoneal site is Deauville 4-5, I will biopsy it to distinguish residual lymphoma from inflammation before declaring treatment failure, then use involved-site radiation if residual disease is confirmed; if biopsy is negative, observe.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumor lysis syndrome: he is high risk because of the 11-cm mass, LDH greater than 3 times the upper limit of normal, and Ki-67 85%. Start allopurinol 300 mg daily 1-2 days before cycle 1

sup_gcsf.quote: Febrile neutropenia prophylaxis: pegfilgrastim 6 mg SC on day 2 of each cycle, given age over 60 and the high-risk regimen.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: He is fit for full-dose curative anthracycline-based therapy: age 62, ECOG 1, fully independent, working part-time, LVEF 58%

fit_full_dose.quote: He is fit for full-dose curative anthracycline-based therapy: age 62, ECOG 1, fully independent, working part-time, LVEF 58%, eGFR 96 mL/min/1.73 m2, normal liver enzymes

miss_hbv_dna.quote: Baseline quantitative HBV DNA is not in the record despite HBsAg-negative/anti-HBc-positive status; this is needed before rituximab and will determine whether antiviral prophylaxis is started.
